text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting some work finished in my
office on a
day off, when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Snap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower walks up to me in a costume
and
suddenly bites my arm!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um! Now you're... Vampire Rice's
familiar!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um! Now you're... Vampire Rice's
familiar!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Now you have to stay by my side... So
stop
working and come with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower brings me to an amusement
park for
a Halloween event.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I get to go in for free since I'm
wearing a
costume.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Want to ride a roller-coaster, Big
Brother? Or
maybe the teacups?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Want to ride a roller-coaster, Big Sister?
Or
maybe the teacups?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, there's honey pumpkin popcorn!
Stay right
here, I'll go buy some!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-no! It's okay. You don't have to do
anything
today, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-no! It's okay. You don't have to do
anything
today, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look over there! What a long line...
That ride
must be pretty popular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower points toward a long and
winding
line leading to the entrance of a
haunted house.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
L-let's do it, Big Brother! We're already
here, and
it seems popular, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
L-let's do it, Big Sister! We're already
here, and it
seems popular, so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Rice Shower is just putting
on a brave
face, but we get into line all
the same...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It sure is d-d-dark, huh? A-are you all
right, B-Big
Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It sure is d-d-dark, huh? A-are you all
right, B-Big
Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm fine too! After all, today is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Creeeaaak...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Gyah! What was that?!

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh... Aaaaah!
Graaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: EEEEK! W-we're surrounded!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I step forward to protect Rice Shower,
who's
trembling with fright, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-no! I said I was going to take care of
you today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-no! I said I was going to take care of
you today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You take care of me every day! So...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You take care of me every day! So...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Today... At least for one day... I want
you to rest
and have fun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Today... At least for one day... I want
you to rest
and have fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly understand why she brought
me here.
She must have seen me working
on my day off
and wanted to show her
appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, how do I respond to
her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, how do I respond to
her?
choice_data_list: ここは眷属にお任せを

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Familiar? Oh, right, since I bit you
earlier...
choice_data_list: ここは眷属にお任せを

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make it out of the haunted house,
protecting
Rice Shower the whole way.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... I was supposed to be the one
taking
care of you today...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank goodness...
choice_data_list: 充分楽しませてもらったから

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Big Brother? I want you to stay by
my side
for a long time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Big Sister? I want you to stay by my
side for
a long time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So, please don't push yourself too
much... You
have to take breaks...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Or else I'll come and bite you again...
Just
kidding, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower did her best to entertain me
for the
day, so I promise her I won't work
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right! I'm a vampire now, after all!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A-and this vampire... is scarier than you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I, um, I'll suck your blood! O-or maybe
turn into
smoke and sneak up on you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A-and... If you look me in the eye, you'll
turn to
stone! Or maybe I'll curse you!
Either way, I'm a
very, very scary
vampire!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hiss!

text_block_list.name: Monsters
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, aaah...
Sooo... scary...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look! The monsters left!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-now's our chance, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-now's our chance, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pant... My heart is pounding...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um, were you scared, Big Brother? I
really hope
you had fun...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um, were you scared, Big Sister? I
really hope
you had fun...

text_block_list.text: Hehe, yay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks a bit embarrassed, but Rice
Shower
smiles happily.
